summary: Garena Free Fire account-abuse automation tool with hardcoded third-party OAuth secret
details: The package is an automation tool whose sole advertised function is mass-registering fake Garena Free Fire guest accounts. nero/main.py implements a WAF-bypass class using a 100,000-entry IP-spoofing pool (randomized X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP headers), rotating device fingerprints, randomized User-Agents, and 2000-thread concurrency against Garena endpoints including 100067.connect.garena.com/api/v2/oauth/guest:register, loginbp.ggbluefox.com, and loginbp.ggblueshark.com. The module also hardcodes a hex-encoded byte string used as client_secret with client_id 100067 in POST bodies to 100067.connect.garena.com/oauth/guest/token/grant, redistributing a Garena OAuth client credential. No installer data is read or exfiltrated; import-time surface only defines a menu function, and the abuse code runs only when the nero CLI is explicitly invoked by an operator. The victims are Garena (ToS violation, fraud, WAF evasion) and the leaked-credential owner (Garena), not the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
